static_traits.name: Lin Rui
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友可谈心,但not yet与其讨论此类Anxiety;因对甜食的Anxiety而回避含糖的Social situations,致与朋友和家人的关系受影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without similar prior problems or psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性好,配合度高;能进行自我Reflection并接受重构;描述Anxiety与Sense of guilt受具体,语气平稳但伴随明显Anxiety;求助动机积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我有一种扭曲的信念,认为享受纸杯蛋糕会使我变得肥胖,并最终死于心脏病.这些信念一直给我带来显著的Anxiety和痛苦.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent anxiety和痛苦已开始影响我的日常生活和幸福感,因此寻求咨询以获得指导和支持.
growth_experiences: 约在六个月前因健康方面的担忧而开始出现关于甜食的Anxiety;Work与Personal life stress使相关想法更突出;此后几乎每天,尤其在用餐或Social gatherings时都会出现Anxiety;尝试通过严格限制饮食与过度运动来对抗这些想法,但not yet能缓解Anxiety.

core_beliefs: 我的饮食一旦not够严格,就会带来灾难性的健康后果.
我的身体是脆弱且not安全的,小的偏差也可能导致严重疾病.

special_situations.event: After eating a cupcake at a friend's party
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I eat sweets, I am seriously harming my health and significantly increasing the risk of heart disease
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterward strictly restricts diet, increases exercise, avoids sugary foods and social occasions with desserts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I made a serious mistake, this will make me fat, and in the end I will have a heart attack.

special_situations.event: Sees sweets (such as cupcakes) at every mealtime
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完全避免甜食,就说明我缺乏自制力,健康会彻底失控
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes rigid diet rules, strictly calculates intake, exercises compulsively to 'hedge'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要吃了一点,我就会控制not住,体重上升,健康走下坡路.

special_situations.event: Recalling health concerns from six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Since I have had worries about health problems before, that means my body is more prone to problems, and even a little sweet food could trigger a big problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 把'零甜食'当成安全准则,Reinforcement饮食控制与回避
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的身体经not起任何甜食的刺激,后果会很严重.

special_situations.event: 在Social gatherings上出现甜点,周围人享用甜食
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我吃了甜食,not yet来一定会出事(增重,心脏病),只是时间问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避Social gatherings或在场景中刻意回避甜食以降低Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I take one bite, there will definitely be serious health problems in the future.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to enjoy food and life with peace of mind and to relax comfortably in social settings
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失去对身体与健康的控制,发展为严重疾病甚至Death
defense_goal: 通过严格控制饮食与过度运动来减少not确定性与Anxiety
Avoids social occasions with sugar to avoid triggered fear

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile individual who needs a high degree of self-control to maintain safety
object_relations.object_representation: Sweets/social occasions are potential threats and temptations that may bring harm

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在Social gatherings上出现甜点或被他人劝食时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把甜食视为会带来严重健康后果的危险刺激('一口也not能吃')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Firmly refuses on the grounds of health risks, in a decisive tone, avoiding further discussion of and contact with the related foods.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在进食甜食后出现强烈Anxiety与Sense of guilt时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将当下的not安归因为'甜食已对身体造成伤害',需要立即弥补
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Immediately arranges high-intensity exercise or formulates a stricter diet plan, speech rate quickens, emphasizing 'must act immediately' to relieve guilt and tension.

manifestations: 将吃甜食与not yet来心脏病发作和Death直接相连
对健康的not确定性感到强烈威胁,反复预想最坏结果
以刚性规则限制饮食与生活方式,减少选择的Freedom
Gaining a 'sense of control' through excessive exercise
为避免接触甜食而回避Social gatherings
Relationships with friends and family affected
outcomes: 支持系统not yet被充分利用,Increased subjective sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Enforces 'eating sweets is necessarily harmful' as an absolute rule
Finds evidence for 'moderation is also fine' hard to accept, tending to insist on rigid health rules

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Redirects the craving for sweets into strict constraints on myself: restricting diet, exercising excessively
出现Anxiety后以自我加压的方式'弥补'而非寻求外部支持

positive_force: Positive help-seeking motivation, willing to try new methods (such as behavioral experiments)
具备一定的理性辨识能力(承认'一次甜食not会毁掉健康')
Having a few close friends who can provide emotional support
Willingness to practice self-observation and cognitive restructuring
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization are significant
将'健康=绝对控制'Introjection为刚性规则,易引发内疚
通过限制饮食,过度运动与Avoids socializing维持Anxiety循环
Work与Personal life stress提升了健康Anxiety的敏感度
用餐与社交场景为高频trigger情境,增强负性条件反射

target_behavior.behavior: 在看到或食用甜食(特do not是纸杯蛋糕)时出现强烈Anxiety与内疚
antecedent: Recalling health concerns from six months ago
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophically links eating sweets with serious health consequences (weight gain, heart attack), amplified by prior health worries and stress
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation中的健康威胁并短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 持续高水平Anxiety与内疚,饮食体验受损,Decreased quality of life

target_behavior.behavior: Strict dietary restriction and excessive exercise (compensatory behaviors)
antecedent: 进食甜食后感到强烈not安
Anticipation自己可能'失控'或'变胖'的念头出现时
target_behavior.core_reason: Hedges catastrophizing beliefs through extreme control, seeking a sense of certainty and security
target_behavior.function: 获得主观的控制感并短期缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reinforcement'甜食=危险'的条件反射,维持与加剧Anxiety循环

antecedent: Being invited to gatherings or celebrations with desserts
Anticipating it will be hard to avoid sweets at the venue
target_behavior.core_reason: 认为一旦接触甜食将not可避免地导致严重后果,从而通过回避来降低威胁
target_behavior.function: 逃避诱发Anxiety的线索与情境
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships受损,Reduced social support,负性信念得not到现实检验
